description: Source code for the Mattermost server's SQL store implementation of channel member history management, including logging join/leave events, querying activity, and cleanup operations.

classes.name: SqlChannelMemberHistoryStore
classes.description: Implementation of channel member history storage and retrieval, including logging join/leave events, querying activity, and cleanup.

methods.name: newSqlChannelMemberHistoryStore
methods.description: Constructor for SqlChannelMemberHistoryStore, initializes query builder.

methods.name: LogJoinEvent
methods.description: Logs a user joining a channel by inserting a record into the history table.

methods.name: LogLeaveEvent
methods.description: Logs a user leaving a channel by updating the leave time in the history table.

methods.name: GetChannelsWithActivityDuring
methods.description: Retrieves channels with activity within a specified time range.

methods.name: GetUsersInChannelDuring
methods.description: Retrieves user membership histories in specified channels during a time range, using either historical data or fallback.

methods.name: hasDataAtOrBefore
methods.description: Checks if there is data in the history table at or before a given time.

methods.name: getFromChannelMemberHistoryTable
methods.description: Fetches user histories from the main history table.

methods.name: getFromChannelMembersTable
methods.description: Fetches user histories from the current channel members table, filling in join/leave times.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteBatchForRetentionPolicies
methods.description: Deletes records affected by retention policies.

methods.name: DeleteOrphanedRows
methods.description: Removes history entries for channels that no longer exist.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteBatch
methods.description: Deletes a batch of history records older than a specified end time.

methods.name: GetChannelsLeftSince
methods.description: Returns channels that a user has left after a certain time and has not rejoined.
